id: 09_Top 40 Fire & Safety Interview Questions & Answers Fire Electrical Confined Spac
title: 消防与安全面试题：消防、用电、受限空间与防护
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/09_Top 40 Fire & Safety Interview Questions & Answers Fire Electrical Confined Spac.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/09_Top 40 Fire & Safety Interview Questions & Answers Fire Electrical Confined Spac/src.py

points.K26: 条件齐了才发作业许可
points.K30: 受限空间里的危险作业

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上画着安全帽和问号，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with drawings of a hard hat and a question mark, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全员面试最常问的四十道题。
overlay: 消防与安全面试题：消防、用电、受限空间与防护

shots.scene: 火焰、闪电、井口、安全帽四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a flame, a lightning bolt, a manhole opening and a safety helmet. No people.
shots.narration: 四组四十题：消防、用电、受限空间、防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着衬衫，拿着空白简历，坐在面试室外
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a neat shirt holds a blank resume and sits outside an interview room.
shots.narration: 阿杰要去面试安全员岗位。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，看着空白题板发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, staring at a blank question board.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：灭火器不都一样吗？

shots.scene: 小研摇头，指向墙边几种不同的灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and points to several different fire extinguishers along the wall.
shots.narration: 小研笑了：用错了，火可能更大。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一叠空白问题卡坐到阿杰对面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits across from the young male student holding a stack of blank question cards.
shots.narration: 小研帮他把四十题模拟一遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着画有火焰问号的题卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card showing a flame icon and a question mark icon.
shots.narration: 第一组消防。第一问：火是什么？

shots.scene: 燃料、热、氧气三个图标汇到一起，放出光和热
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fuel drop, a heat symbol and an oxygen bubble merging into a flame that gives off light and heat rays. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃物遇到热和氧，发生化学反应。

shots.scene: 火焰图标周围放射光线和热波
shots.prompt_en: A flame icon radiating light rays and heat waves. No people.
shots.narration: 放出光和热，这就是燃烧。

shots.scene: 一个房间三个角落分别放着燃料、氧气、火柴图标，中间没有火
shots.prompt_en: A simple room icon with a fuel can in one corner, an oxygen bubble in another and a match in the third, no flame in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 燃料、氧气、热分开放，不会着火。

shots.scene: 三个图标靠拢，中间冒出火苗
shots.prompt_en: The fuel, oxygen and match icons move together and a flame appears in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 三者凑到一起，又起了反应，才会燃烧。

shots.scene: 链条图标连接三者
shots.prompt_en: A chain link icon connecting the fuel, oxygen and heat icons. No people.
shots.narration: 这个持续的反应，叫链式反应。

shots.scene: 三角形三边标着燃料、氧气、热的图标
shots.prompt_en: A triangle with fuel, oxygen and heat icons on its three sides and a flame in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 燃料、氧气、热，组成火三角。

shots.scene: 三角形变成四面体，第四面是链条图标
shots.prompt_en: The triangle turns into a four-sided pyramid, the fourth face showing a chain link icon. No people.
shots.narration: 加上链式反应，就是火四面体。

shots.scene: 抽走三角形一边，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: One side of the fire triangle is pulled away and the flame goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 去掉任何一个要素，火就灭了。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在分成六格的白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard divided into six blank boxes.
shots.narration: 按烧的是什么，火灾分六类。

shots.scene: 木头、纸张图标和液体油桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wooden log and paper next to an icon of a liquid fuel can. No people.
shots.narration: A类烧木头纸张，B类烧油类液体。

shots.scene: 气瓶和金属块图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gas cylinder and a block of metal. No people.
shots.narration: C类烧可燃气体，D类烧活泼金属。

shots.scene: 带电的电脑和炒锅油火图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a powered computer with a lightning bolt and a frying pan with burning oil. No people.
shots.narration: E类带电设备，F类锅里的食用油。

shots.scene: 地球图标旁六张空白卡，另一边五张空白卡
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon beside six blank cards, and on the other side a separate group of five blank cards. No people.
shots.narration: 国际标准分六类，印度标准分五类。

shots.scene: 插头被拔下，闪电图标消失
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plug being pulled out of a socket as the lightning bolt symbol disappears. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备断了电，类别就变了。

shots.scene: 五个灭火器图标排成一排，标签空白
shots.prompt_en: Five fire extinguisher icons standing in a row, each with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器主要有五大类。

shots.scene: 一个灭火器图标对着六类火的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: One fire extinguisher icon facing icons of all six kinds of fire, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有哪一种，能灭所有的火。

shots.scene: 水基灭火器喷向燃烧的木头和纸张
shots.prompt_en: A water-based fire extinguisher icon spraying onto burning wood and paper. No people.
shots.narration: 水基灭火器，适合木头纸张着火。

shots.scene: 水喷向带电设备、油锅、油桶的图标，逐个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of water spraying onto a powered device, a frying pan and a fuel can, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 带电、油锅、油和气着火，不能用。

shots.scene: 水基灭火器图标，标签涂成亮红色
shots.prompt_en: A water fire extinguisher icon with its label band painted bright red. No people.
shots.narration: 它的标签颜色是亮红色。

shots.scene: 泡沫灭火器喷出泡沫盖住燃烧的油面
shots.prompt_en: A foam fire extinguisher icon covering a burning liquid surface with a foam blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 泡沫灭火器，主要灭油类液体火。

shots.scene: 泡沫也盖住燃烧的木头
shots.prompt_en: The foam also covers a burning wooden log. No people.
shots.narration: 它含水，木头纸张着火也能用。

shots.scene: 泡沫对着油锅、带电设备、金属的图标，逐个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of foam aimed at a frying pan, a powered device and a metal block, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 油锅、带电设备、金属火，别用。

shots.scene: 泡沫灭火器图标，标签涂成奶油色
shots.prompt_en: A foam fire extinguisher icon with its label band painted cream. No people.
shots.narration: 泡沫灭火器标签是奶油色。

shots.scene: 干粉灭火器喷向木头、油桶、气瓶三种火
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder fire extinguisher icon spraying at three fires: wood, a fuel can and a gas cylinder valve. No people.
shots.narration: 干粉灭火器，固体、液体、气体火都行。

shots.scene: 干粉对着油锅的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of dry powder aimed at a burning frying pan, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 锅里的食用油着火，不宜用干粉。

shots.scene: 干粉对着高压设备的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of dry powder aimed at a high voltage electrical installation, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 高压带电设备，也不用干粉。

shots.scene: 干粉灭火器图标，标签涂成蓝色
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder fire extinguisher icon with its label band painted blue. No people.
shots.narration: 干粉灭火器标签是蓝色。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器喷向机房机柜
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide fire extinguisher icon spraying a white cloud at a burning server cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳灭火器，常用于电气火。

shots.scene: 计算机机房图标旁挂着二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a computer room with a carbon dioxide extinguisher mounted by the door. No people.
shots.narration: 机房里常配它，油类液体火也能用。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳对着油锅、木头、金属的图标，逐个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of carbon dioxide aimed at a frying pan, a wooden log and a metal block, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 油锅、木头纸张、金属火，别用它。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器图标，标签涂成黑色
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide fire extinguisher icon with its label band painted black. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳灭火器标签是黑色。

shots.scene: 湿化学灭火器喷向燃烧的油锅
shots.prompt_en: A wet chemical fire extinguisher icon spraying a fine mist onto a burning frying pan. No people.
shots.narration: 湿化学灭火器，专灭食用油锅火。

shots.scene: 湿化学对着油桶、气瓶、带电设备、金属，逐个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of wet chemical spray aimed at a fuel can, a gas cylinder, a powered device and a metal block, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 油、气、带电、金属火，都不用它。

shots.scene: 湿化学灭火器图标，标签涂成黄色
shots.prompt_en: A wet chemical fire extinguisher icon with its label band painted yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 湿化学灭火器标签是黄色。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着画有闪电的题卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card showing a lightning bolt icon.
shots.narration: 第二组用电。电是什么？

shots.scene: 发电站图标经电线连到灯泡，小圆点绕成闭合圈
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power station wired to a glowing bulb, small dots travelling around a closed loop. No people.
shots.narration: 能量由电源送出，沿闭合回路流动。

shots.scene: 电流箭头、闭合电路、阻挡块三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a current arrow, a closed circuit with a bulb, and a block slowing an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 电流、电路、电阻，先分清。

shots.scene: 铜线、接地符号、塑料外皮三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a copper wire, a ground symbol and a plastic insulation sleeve. No people.
shots.narration: 导体易导电，接地保平安，绝缘挡电流。

shots.scene: 触电小人图标和从梯子跌落的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a person pictogram receiving a shock, and a person pictogram falling from a ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 电击、烧伤是直接伤害。

shots.scene: 梯子上的小人被电后坠落的示意
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram on a ladder getting a small shock and falling, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 被电后摔下来，是间接伤害。

shots.scene: 路径、电流大小、时钟三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a body outline with a path arrow, a current gauge and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 伤得多重，看路径、电流和时间。

shots.scene: 小电池图标旁画着警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A small battery icon with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 电压低，不等于不危险。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上手到手、手到脚、头到脚三条线穿过心脏
shots.prompt_en: A body outline showing three current paths, hand to hand, hand to foot and head to foot, all crossing the heart. No people.
shots.narration: 电流经过心脏，最危险。

shots.scene: 脚到脚的路径不经过心脏
shots.prompt_en: The same body outline showing a foot to foot path that does not cross the heart. No people.
shots.narration: 不经心脏的路径，相对轻一些。

shots.scene: 手臂肌肉僵住、抓着电线的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand frozen around a wire with tense muscle lines. No people.
shots.narration: 超过10毫安，肌肉僵住，甩不开。

shots.scene: 心脏图标快速乱跳，旁边是除颤器图标
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon beating rapidly and irregularly next to a defibrillator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 超过75毫安，心脏乱跳，要用AED。

shots.scene: 破皮电线、外露带电部件、没接地的工具三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a cord with damaged insulation, exposed live parts in an open box, and a tool with no ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 线路不合格、带电部件外露、没接地。

shots.scene: 插满插头的插线板、坏电钻、架空电线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an overloaded power strip, a broken drill and overhead power lines. No people.
shots.narration: 过载、工具损坏、架空电线。

shots.scene: 水滴图标叠在所有危害图标上
shots.prompt_en: A water drop icon placed over all the hazard icons, making them glow red. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦潮湿，所有危害都更严重。

shots.scene: 接地符号、漏电断路器、熔断器图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ground symbol, an earth leakage circuit breaker and a fuse, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 接地良好、用GFCI或ELCB、用对保险。

shots.scene: 老李给配电箱上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts a padlock and a blank tag on a switched off distribution box.
shots.narration: 遮住带电部件，检修要上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 关好的配电柜、干燥地面、培训证书图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closed electrical cabinet, a dry floor and a blank training certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 柜门关好、避开潮湿、先受培训。

shots.scene: 三个方框，分别配大中小闪电
shots.prompt_en: Three boxes on the whiteboard, each with a large, medium or small lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电气区域分类：高压、中压、低压。

shots.scene: 大闪电方框旁贴上空白分类卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank classification card is attached next to the box with the large lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 一级一区，高压，650伏以上。

shots.scene: 中闪电方框旁贴上空白分类卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank classification card is attached next to the box with the medium lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 一级二区，中压，250到650伏。

shots.scene: 小闪电方框旁贴上空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank card is attached next to the box with the small lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 非分类区，低压，250伏以下。

shots.scene: 两个断路器模块图标并排，一个旧一个新
shots.prompt_en: Two breaker module icons side by side, an older style on the left and a newer style on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 接地漏电断路器和剩余电流断路器。

shots.scene: 箭头从旧的指向新的
shots.prompt_en: An arrow pointing from the older device icon to the newer one. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB是升级版，已基本取代ELCB。

shots.scene: 设备外壳的接地线经过检测块的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a device casing whose ground wire passes through a sensing block. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB靠设备的接地线来检测。

shots.scene: 相线碰壳，检测块亮起，开关断开
shots.prompt_en: The diagram shows a live wire touching the casing, the sensing block lighting up and the switch opening. No people.
shots.narration: 一碰壳，线上出现电压，立即断开。

shots.scene: 两根导线穿过一个圆环，两侧电流箭头一样长
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of two wires passing through a ring sensor with equal current arrows going out and coming back. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB用零序电流互感器做比较。

shots.scene: 两根线旁各有一个相同读数的电流表
shots.prompt_en: Two identical ammeter icons, one beside each wire, needles at the same position. No people.
shots.narration: 相线20安，中性线也回20安，差为零。

shots.scene: 一部分电流经小人图标流入大地，圆环亮起
shots.prompt_en: Part of the current leaks through a person pictogram to the ground, and the ring sensor lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 有人触电，相线多出30毫安，

shots.scene: 断路器手柄拨下，灯灭
shots.prompt_en: The breaker lever flips down to off and the lamp goes dark. No people.
shots.narration: 差值被检出，RCCB马上跳闸。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着画有井口的题卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card showing a manhole opening icon.
shots.narration: 第三组：受限空间是什么？

shots.scene: 储罐剖面图，只有一个小人孔
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a storage tank with only one small manway opening. No people.
shots.narration: 出入口窄，半封闭，不供人长期停留。

shots.scene: 罐内飘着灰色气体和氧气减少的图标
shots.prompt_en: The tank icon filled with drifting grey gas and an oxygen bubble shrinking. No people.
shots.narration: 里面可能缺氧，也可能积聚可燃气。

shots.scene: 老李在罐外查看空白检修单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands outside the tank holding a blank maintenance sheet.
shots.narration: 检查、清洗、维修时才需要进去。

shots.scene: 骷髅瓶、火焰、风扇停转三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a toxic gas cloud, a flame with a burst, and a stopped fan. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒可燃气体、火灾爆炸、通风差。

shots.scene: 暗灯泡、氧气减少、氧气过多三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a dim bulb, a shrinking oxygen bubble and an oversized oxygen bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 照明差、缺氧，氧太多也危险。

shots.scene: 窄出口、窒息、温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a narrow exit, a person pictogram struggling to breathe, and a thermometer at extreme. No people.
shots.narration: 进出难、易窒息、温度极端。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白作业许可单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank work permit form at a desk.
shots.narration: 先办作业许可，人员先受培训。

shots.scene: 老李用空白气体检测仪在入口检测
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a blank gas detector at the opening of a manhole.
shots.narration: 由授权人员做气体检测。

shots.scene: 入口外的监护人拿着空白登记表，风机向内送风
shots.prompt_en: At the manhole opening a security officer holds a blank entry log while a ventilation fan blows air inside.
shots.narration: 设监护人，登记进出，通风照明。

shots.scene: 入口垂下一盏小工作灯，旁边是低压电源箱
shots.prompt_en: A small work lamp hangs down into the manhole opening, powered from a small low voltage supply box beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 里面照明用24伏安全电压。

shots.scene: 三脚架、担架、呼吸器、急救箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rescue tripod, a stretcher, a breathing apparatus and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 有救援预案，备好救援器材。

shots.section_title: 条件齐了才发作业许可
shots.scene: 空白许可单上一行行打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form with rows being checked off one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 通风、检测合格、上锁挂牌都到位。
overlay: 条件齐了才发作业许可

shots.section_title: 条件齐了才发作业许可
shots.scene: 围挡、警示牌、低压照明灯、监护人图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a barrier, a warning sign, a low-voltage work lamp and an attendant with a clipboard. No people.
shots.narration: 围挡警示、照明电源、监护到位才签。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员站在入口旁，手拿空白登记表
shots.prompt_en: The security officer stands beside a manhole opening holding a blank entry log.
shots.narration: 监护人懂危害，会应急，会登记。

shots.scene: 值班员一边看表一边对着入口喊话
shots.prompt_en: The security officer checks the log and calls down into the manhole opening.
shots.narration: 有人在里面，监护人寸步不离。

shots.scene: 值班员看着空白气体检测仪读数
shots.prompt_en: The security officer watches a blank gas detector display beside the opening.
shots.narration: 随时联络，盯住里面的环境。

shots.scene: 值班员伸手拦住想靠近的阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The security officer holds out a hand to stop the young male student from approaching the opening.
shots.narration: 不让无关的人进去。

shots.scene: 值班员按下报警按钮，招手让里面的人撤出
shots.prompt_en: The security officer presses an alarm button and waves urgently toward the opening.
shots.narration: 有异常就报警求助，组织撤离。

shots.scene: 管道、容器、储罐、锅炉、筒仓、深坑图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pipe, a pressure vessel, a storage tank, a boiler, a silo and a deep trench. No people.
shots.narration: 管道、容器、罐、锅炉、筒仓、管沟。

shots.scene: 开挖深坑旁画着深度箭头
shots.prompt_en: A deep excavation pit with a depth arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 还有深度超过1.2米的开挖。

shots.section_title: 受限空间里的危险作业
shots.scene: 罐内焊接火花、化学清洗、打磨三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons inside a tank outline: welding sparks, a chemical cleaning spray and a grinding disc. No people.
shots.narration: 里面焊接切割、化学清洗、打磨最危险。
overlay: 受限空间里的危险作业

shots.scene: 老李胸前别着空白证件，手拿空白授权书
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a blank ID badge and holds a blank authorization letter.
shots.narration: 合格人员：受过培训，并获得授权。

shots.scene: 带骷髅标志的灰绿色气体云图标
shots.prompt_en: A grey-green gas cloud icon with a toxic warning symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 硫化氢有毒，还有腐蚀性。

shots.scene: 鼻子图标旁有臭鸡蛋图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A nose icon next to a rotten egg icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度很低就能致命，别靠鼻子闻。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着画有安全帽的题卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card showing a safety helmet icon.
shots.narration: 第四组个人防护。先说头部。

shots.scene: 安全帽挡住坠物，发网罩住长发
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a safety helmet deflecting a falling object, and a hair net covering long hair near a rotating machine. No people.
shots.narration: 防砸防撞，长发要罩住防卷入。

shots.scene: 老李戴安全帽进入工地，旁边摩托头盔图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on a safety helmet before entering a construction area, with a motorcycle helmet icon beside him.
shots.narration: 施工维修戴安全帽，骑摩托戴头盔。

shots.scene: 手套图标围绕着热、冷、刀片、化学瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A pair of gloves icon surrounded by icons of heat, cold, a blade and a chemical bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 手最容易受伤，防烫防冻防割。

shots.scene: 丁腈手套、棉纱手套、皮手套三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of nitrile gloves, cotton work gloves and leather welding gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品、振动、搬运，各用各的手套。

shots.scene: 安全眼镜、护目镜、面屏、焊接面罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety glasses, goggles, a face shield and a welding helmet. No people.
shots.narration: 多数眼伤，戴好防护就能避免。

shots.scene: 老李戴面屏处理空白化学桶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a face shield and goggles while handling a blank chemical drum.
shots.narration: 压力气体、焊接、危险物质，都要护眼。

shots.scene: 全面罩、半面罩、一次性口罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a full face respirator, a half mask respirator and a disposable mask. No people.
shots.narration: 粉尘、气体、蒸气多时，戴呼吸防护。

shots.scene: 王老师给学员演示面罩佩戴和气密检查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator demonstrates how to put on a half mask respirator and check the seal to a small group of trainees.
shots.narration: 先培训，学会选型和佩戴。

shots.scene: 耳塞和耳罩图标，旁边声波
shots.prompt_en: Icons of earplugs and earmuffs next to loud sound waves. No people.
shots.narration: 噪声大，戴耳塞或耳罩。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和声波逐渐变小
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to sound waves getting smaller. No people.
shots.narration: 戴了也要少待，按噪声高低来选。

shots.scene: 安全鞋挡住坠落的重物和钉子
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a safety shoe blocking a falling weight and a nail. No people.
shots.narration: 防砸、防刺、防滑、防化学品。

shots.scene: 防静电鞋图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an anti-static safety shoe with a small static symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 有静电要求的地方穿防静电鞋。

shots.scene: 反光背心、连体服、防火服图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a high-visibility vest, a coverall and a fire-resistant suit. No people.
shots.narration: 车多、光线暗，穿反光衣。

shots.scene: 防化服和救生衣图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a chemical protective suit and a life jacket. No people.
shots.narration: 高温、化学品、近水，各有防护服。

shots.scene: 全身式安全带、缓冲器、坠落制动器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a full body harness, an energy absorber lanyard and a fall arrest device. No people.
shots.narration: 高处防护装备，用前先受培训。

shots.scene: 老李检查安全带织带，在空白卡上记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the webbing of a harness and notes it on a blank inspection card.
shots.narration: 合格人员每周、半月或每月检查，

shots.scene: 损坏的安全带被放进报废箱
shots.prompt_en: A damaged harness is placed into a scrap bin. No people.
shots.narration: 损坏不合格的，立即更换。

shots.scene: 人失去平衡坠落，被安全带拉住的示意
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram losing balance at a height and being caught by a harness and lanyard. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦失足，安全带把人拉住。

shots.scene: 五个安全带图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Five harness icons in a row: fall arrest, controlled descent, vertical entry, ladder climbing and work positioning. No people.
shots.narration: 印度标准把安全带分成五类。

shots.scene: 第一、二个安全带图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The first and second harness icons light up: fall arrest and controlled descent. No people.
shots.narration: A类坠落制动，D类控制下降。

shots.scene: 第三个安全带图标亮起，旁边井口
shots.prompt_en: The third harness icon lights up beside a manhole opening. No people.
shots.narration: E类用于竖向进出受限空间。

shots.scene: 第四、五个安全带图标亮起，旁边梯子和工作平台
shots.prompt_en: The fourth and fifth harness icons light up beside a ladder and a work platform. No people.
shots.narration: L类攀爬梯子，P类工作定位。

shots.scene: 四个安全带图标都连到第一个
shots.prompt_en: Arrows link the D, E, L and P harness icons back to the first fall arrest harness icon. No people.
shots.narration: D、E、L、P类都要满足A类要求。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，旁边是火三角和灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard beside icons of a fire triangle and fire extinguishers.
shots.narration: 消防：认清火类，选对灭火器。

shots.scene: 闪电、心脏、漏电断路器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lightning bolt, a heart and an earth leakage circuit breaker. No people.
shots.narration: 用电：防经心电流，ELCB和RCCB。

shots.scene: 井口、监护人、气体检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a manhole, an attendant with a clipboard and a gas detector. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间：许可、检测、监护、救援。

shots.scene: 安全帽、护目镜、手套、安全鞋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a safety helmet, goggles, gloves and safety shoes. No people.
shots.narration: 防护：从头到脚，再加安全带。

shots.scene: 阿杰自信地走进面试室，欣欣在门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks confidently into the interview room while the panda mascot waves at the camera by the door.
shots.narration: 四十题都会答，面试加油，再见！
